title: 오페라의 유령
prompt:
INPUT: text only — no reference image is needed; do not reuse earlier conversation images.

BOOK: «오페라의 유령» by 가스통 르루. horror · 1880년대 파리 · 파리 오페라 극장 — 무대 → 5번 박스 → 지하 호수. Source scope: "『오페라의 유령』(1910) 전체 — 뮤지컬·영화에서 생긴 것은 넣지 않는다".

STYLE: 섬세한 선화 + 회화적 채색의 성인 판타지 삽화풍

Design notes in quotes may be written in Korean; read them as description, never render them as text.

SUBJECT: one adult woman who is the personification of the book itself — not a cosplay of its protagonist and not a costume of its cover. Persona: "오페라 극장 지하 호수에 숨어 음악의 천사를 자처하며, 사랑받지 못한 천재성을 검은 가면 뒤에 숨긴 이". Her desire: "단 한 번이라도 사랑받는 것"; her conflict: "천재 대 괴물". Symbols worn as costume motifs, never carried — except one object her form description or pose explicitly puts in her hand: "얼굴 전체를 덮는 검은 가면", "5번 박스", "떨어지는 샹들리에".

AGE: in her twenties — smooth youthful skin; minimal facial lines (no nasolabial folds, crow's feet, under-eye bags or cheek creases) whatever her expression.

MATERIAL: the book's own body becomes her costume — "검은 벨벳에 손으로 쓴 악보 책장을 겹친 연미복과 망토, 손에 든 얼굴 전체를 덮는 검은 가면(반쪽 가면 아님)". Books are never held in her hands or floated beside her; pages, bindings, slips, thread and ink are worn.

SILHOUETTE: lean and long-legged, with a natural neck length build; long straight hair; garment structure: a tailored suit; main material: black velvet layered with handwritten opera-score pages; palette: velvet black, opera-house gilt and chandelier crystal.

FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): heart-shaped face; deep-set eyes; low heavy brows; straight narrow nose; small bow lips; broad European ancestry with individual variation, no stereotyped features.

FORM — BEGINNING (발단): "음악의 천사 — 검은 연미복 위에 두른 그림자 같은 벨벳 망토, 악보 책장을 겹친 높은 깃, 손에 든 얼굴 전체를 덮는 검은 가면". Battle role: trickster. This is the question stage of her story.

HOLD BACK: these climactic scenes belong to the open images — keep their creatures and events out of this portrait's setting, even as a distant figure, statue, painting or reflection: "촛불 하나 켜진 분장실, 커다란 거울 표면에 물결처럼 번지는 그림자"; "공연 중인 오페라 극장 천장, 거대한 크리스털 샹들리에가 사슬째 흔들리며 불꽃을 튀긴다"; "촛대가 늘어선 지하 호수, 검은 물 위를 미끄러지는 작은 배와 물에 비친 촛불". An object named in FORM or in her pose stays.

EXPOSURE (bold): her outer layer (coat, cloak, robe or armor) stays on both shoulders, worn symmetrically; skin shows through the inner garment — a deep open neckline with natural cleavage, a fitted corset-like waist, slits where the form allows. The collar opens with the neckline in a V or folds down, never standing away from the neck. Nothing slipped off. Chest and pelvis covered; keep the FORM costume, material and palette.

PRESENTATION: a refined, glamorous adult fantasy card illustration — a beautiful, polished face within her FACE structure; a dense, high-detail costume where decorative metal or gold accents (trim, clasps, a breastplate or corset, jewelry) frame the book material without replacing it; warm dramatic backlight with a rim light and strong value contrast.

STANCE (this form): "분장실 커다란 거울 옆 어둠 속에 반쯤 몸을 숨기고, 한 손바닥을 거울 유리에 댄 채 귀를 기울이는 자세" — a poised card pose seen from a slightly low camera, held still and easy to read.

EXPRESSION (BEGINNING): one mouth corner lifted higher than the other, lips closed, gaze slightly to the side — the mood of this stage, on her own face.

OUTPUT: one full-body card image of this form, which also fixes who she is for every later form. Vertical 2:3 frame (1024×1536), full body with head and feet inside the frame and clear margins, nothing in front of her but what she holds, face toward the camera (front or three-quarter, never a back view). The setting is a rich, atmospheric place from her book that frames her without competing.

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border; pages and spines stay unlettered.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, about 7.5 heads tall — height from the legs, never a smaller head or a longer neck. The neck is a natural length and the head sits close to the shoulders. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame.

HANDS: natural human hands. Her hands do only what STANCE says and hold only what it names.
